{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the first few values of revenue to confirm it's string with commas
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of commas in revenue
print('Any revenue values contain commas?', df['revenue'].str.contains(r',').any())

# Also check for the 999999.99 sentinel values
print('Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99:', (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
